name: Crowlie
source:
The Scarecrow

Love Tendency: Not very expressive of his feelings but earnest.
Place: Emerald City
Motto: In the middle of knowledge lies wisdom.

Crowlie is one of your friends who went on the journey together: the Scarecrow who got brains from Oz. The brainiest one of all, he often gives advice to his friends. He is serious and often scolds Leonardo, who is happy-go-lucky.
Having succeeded Oz, he is king in the Emerald City and wisely guides his people. Now that he is human and has a heart, he gets confused with his feelings. Despite of his confusions, he is happy to be human because he has more things in common with you.

[Official in-game description]
